description:
Remote support made easy, quick and secure.

Supremo is a lightweight software for multi-platform remote support, remote monitoring and management, helpdesk and cybersecurity chosen by over 1.4 million users every day.
It requires no router or firewall configuration, so you can start or receive a remote session in seconds.
Connections are protected end-to-end (UAC compatibility, random passwords regenerated at every start, Two-Factor Authentication, ID Whitelist and anti-brute force system) and Supremo can start for unattended access to computers and servers.
It includes secure file transfer, remote printing, integrated chat, online address book with contacts sharing, connection reports, automatic updates and cross-platform sessions with Windows, macOS, Android and iOS devices.

Among the advanced features for IT teams, MSPs, support teams and SMBs:
- Advanced RMM: real-time monitoring of system health and performance (CPU, RAM), management of Windows processes, services and events, security alerts, hardware and software inventory, and Patch Management to identify missing updates and reduce vulnerabilities and downtime.
- Support Queue and service management: centralized ticket management with priority and group assignment, integrated remote connection, KPI and performance dashboards, ticket history and exportable reports.
- Branding and mass deployment: fully branded clients with custom logo, interface and messages, settings managed from a single control panel, and automatic large-scale deployment across the whole IT infrastructure — no manual installation on each endpoint.
- Advanced reports and accounting: detailed activity tracking per customer or contract, transparent session reports, data export for invoicing on third-party systems, supporting both pay-per-use and subscription billing models.
- "IT Security" add-on: AI-powered endpoint threat detection and alerting - powered by the LECS technology - based on behavioral analysis of users, systems and networks, managed centrally from the Supremo Console.

Supremo is licensed by simultaneous connections and, for the RMM feature, also by monitored devices — not per technician — with unlimited installations and devices for remote access. A free trial is available.
